title: tenable_sc_admin_credential data block
description: The `data` block of a `tenable_sc_admin_credential` secret: the API keys of a Security Center administrator, used ONLY for the inventory reads an organisation user cannot make in full. Those reads are the scanner, passive-scanner, zone and organization lists (req-tenable-connection-11, ruled 2026-11-12, Q51). This envelope is optional. Without it, those reads fall back to what the main credential can see, and the run records them as not visible. The admin client never sends an analysis query or any read the main envelope makes. It must name a main envelope in for_key, and both must resolve to the same instance, or it is refused. Strict: every field is described, and fields not listed here are refused.

base_url.description: The Security Center root, written so it resolves to the same instance key as the main envelope's base_url. The URL rules are the same as for tenable_sc_credential.

access_key.description: The administrator's API access key. Never printed, logged, stored on a node or placed in a URL.

secret_key.description: The administrator's API secret key. Never printed, logged, stored on a node or placed in a URL.

ssl_verify.description: Whether to verify the instance's TLS certificate. Defaults to true and is always passed explicitly. false is honoured and recorded as for the main envelope.

ca_bundle.description: The absolute path of a PEM file on the host holding the CA certificates to trust for this instance. Give the path, never the file's contents.

for_key.description: The key of the tenable_sc_credential envelope (scope tenable) this administrator envelope serves.
